== Strategy ==

This is My attempt at creating A Hidden Base deck that will stand up to a LSC deck. Basic Strategy is like WYS - Drop characters in ships and drain for one. The Raltiir captains can go from Raltiir to Kessel and retrieve 10 each time. Massive, i know.

Basically, Im trying to circumvent the restriction placed on me by WYS. Its not as flashy, but it gets the job done. I havent played it against another person (i have only me to compete with) so its a bit iffy. In my games, the main weakness i saw was the card hands i had.

Here it Goes:

The Objective is never flipped. Deploy the systems and deploy some ships. Try to get im on the leader out and use the other powerful cards to drain there. Play some kessel runs every once and a while (Watch for Secret PLans) and retrieve force. For LSC protection i added some jedi to the mix, as well as the light side EE for balance. Basically i try to outlast the opponent in the game. careful drains of 1 or 2 will win the round.
